claims.text: Focusing message recipients on descriptive normative information regarding wood theft increased theft.
Focusing message recipients on injunctive normative information regarding wood theft suppressed theft.
Normative information in persuasive appeals can normalize either desirable or undesirable conduct.

evidence.description: Field experimental results at Arizona's Petrified Forest National Park showed that focusing message recipients on descriptive normative information was most likely to increase theft.
Field experimental results at Arizona's Petrified Forest National Park showed that focusing message recipients on injunctive normative information was most likely to suppress theft.

methodologies.name: Field experiment on normative messaging
methodologies.description: Exposed park visitors to signage admonishing against the theft of petrified wood conveying either descriptive norms or injunctive norms.
datasets: Petrified Forest National Park visitor theft observations
